what: The R-normalization premise that makes a harness risk default 'not matter' is structurally untestable here: the fleet's core harness computes a raw float qty with no whole-contract floor, no min_qty, no whole-share floor and no sub-1 refusal, while 24 of 52 routed legs run on a venue that applies all of them. Below a threshold the trade does not shrink, it does not HAPPEN -- so the trade population is a function of the very parameter the harness declares irrelevant, and it fails in the flattering direction.
